title: 11.11. Vedanāttika, Vipākattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṁ navipākaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto navipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā ekūnapaññāsa …pe… purejāte āsevane aṭṭhacattālīsa …pe… avigate ekūnapaññāsa. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
